CONTRACT_OWNER: {{DECISION: TerpNET DAO core or ops multisig}}
_wavs_doc: null = WAVS disabled (recommended for v1); or a BLS operator-set PoP object from the operators. Only gov (wasm admin, via migrate) can change it later.
_cutoff_doc: auto = latest mainnet height + 2 years at the last-10k-block mean, computed at render time (2026-10-27 example: 39129426). Claims and registration close after it; then the sweep burns what is left.
_anchor_doc: Blocks between accepted anchors: 3430 = ~4h at 4.2s. "auto" = 4h at the same last-10k-block mean used for CUTOFF_HEIGHT.
_hook_doc: Optional. terp1 contract executed (no funds, gas-capped, errors ignored) once per identity when its note list completes, with {headstash_registered:{campaign,id_tag,identity,note_count,reward_addr}}. Immutable after instantiate. Empty = no hook. It publicly links the eligible identity to reward_addr. Optional REGISTRATION_HOOK_GAS_LIMIT (default 500000).

_doc: Any {{...}} value makes render.py exit 1. foundation-dao takes exactly one operator (the dedicated foundation fee granter); total budget >= 4761.7 THIOL recommended. Dry run: render.py --dry-run --circuit DIR
_lane_only_doc: Only read when LANE_PATH is true (optional hashmerchant lane path, not v1). With LANE_PATH false these are ignored and nothing lane, custody or oracle related is rendered.
